definitions.explanation: The work or type of work that someone does as their regular employment.

examples.japanese: ご{職業|しょくぎょう}は{何|なん}ですか。
examples.notes: Formal way to ask about someone's job

examples.japanese: {職業|しょくぎょう}{選択|せんたく}の{自由|じゆう}は{憲法|けんぽう}で{保障|ほしょう}されている。
examples.english: Freedom of occupational choice is guaranteed by the constitution.

examples.japanese: {職業|しょくぎょう}{訓練|くんれん}を{受|う}けて{新|あたら}しいスキルを{身|み}につけた。
examples.english: I acquired new skills through vocational training.

notes:
{職業|しょくぎょう} is more formal than {仕事|しごと}.

COMPARISON:
- {職業|しょくぎょう}: formal, used on forms and in official contexts
- {仕事|しごと}: general/neutral, everyday use
- お{仕事|しごと}: polite, conversational

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {職業|しょくぎょう}{訓練|くんれん} (vocational training)
- {職業|しょくぎょう}{紹介|しょうかい} (job placement)
- {職業|しょくぎょう}{病|びょう} (occupational disease)
- {職業|しょくぎょう}{意識|いしき} (professional awareness)
